what: Design `oos` uses `grep -cE '^\| OOS_[0-9]+ \|'` on the whole Findings table, but tally-plan-review.sh prints every ballot id there with its Result (accepted/rejected/exonerated)
scenario_or_breakage: Rejected or exonerated OOS rows still match the grep, so `rounds[].oos` overstates accepted OOS and disagrees with tally semantics / `oos-accepted-design.md`
suggested_fix: Count only accepted OOS rows (e.g. awk on `voting-tally.md` Findings lines where the Result field is `accepted`, including security-accepted rows absent from `oos-accepted-design.md`); align `scripts/test-timing-report.sh` fixture expectations
